result:
Inbound invoice emails are handled by `InvoiceEmailService`. A scheduled job (`ParseInvoiceEmailsJob.java:21`) calls `handleUnparsedEmails` (`InvoiceEmailService.java:90`). That method reads each raw email from the S3 `invoices/` prefix.

Most failures are recorded in the `emailReceivingRecord` table. Its `errors` column is `EmailReceivingRecord.java:27`, and the row is saved at `InvoiceEmailService.java:166`. The admin UI reads these rows through `getErrors` (`InvoiceEmailService.java:243`). Failures before a record is saved go to `orderlyLogger` instead.

| Reason | Where recorded |
|---|---|
| Job doesn't run in dev (`isDev()` returns early) | Nowhere. It's silent (`InvoiceEmailService.java:91`). |
| Email can't be parsed (`UnparsableMessageException`, thrown at `FallbackMimeParser.java:40` and `:50`) | `orderlyLogger.logException` tagged `InvoiceEmail` (`:182`). The file is moved to S3 `unparsable/<key>` (`:183`). No DB record. |
| Any other exception in `handleEmail` (for example `EmailParser.java:51` "Failed to parse email", or `EmailAttachmentExtractor.java:202` "Could not read email attachment") | `orderlyLogger.logException` with `failedEmailFile` (`:168`) and again with `s3Key` (`:185`). The email stays in `invoices/` and is retried on the next run. No DB record. |
| Error reading the To/Cc/Bcc recipients | `errors` column: "Exception trying to add to, cc, or bcc emails" (`InvoiceRecipientResolver.java:76`) |
| No address looks like `<id>@invoices…`, so the file goes to S3 `noLocalPart/` | `errors` column (`InvoiceEmailService.java:162-163`) |
| Local part isn't a known restaurant id, so the file goes to S3 `unknown/<localPart>/`. Non-numeric ids and lookup exceptions are silently swallowed (`:200-202`). | `errors` column (`:160`) |
| Restaurant is inactive | `errors` column: "Restaurant was not marked active" (`:125`) |
| Attachment isn't an image type (`JPEG`, `PNG`, `BMP`, `PDF`, `JPG`, `GIF`) or a text type (`TXT`, `CSV`) (`:52-53`, `:141`) | `errors` column: "<name> was not image or text type file" |
| Attachment is `TXT` or `CSV` and the sender's domain has no supplier mapping. Only `rnc.sysco.com` is mapped (`:69`, `:138`). | `errors` column |
| Saving the grouping or attachment throws (`:129-130`, caught at `:143`) | `errors` column: "<name> -- <message>" |
| No attachment found at all (for example an inline or oddly encoded PDF) | The record has an empty `allAttachments` column, and no error is added. |
| The PDF was saved but you can't find it afterwards (`:129-131`) | The name appears in `attachmentsMoved`. Check the restaurant's filing cabinet or invoice grouping. |

If you're debugging one email, search `emailReceivingRecord` by `localPart` or `fromEmail` first. If there's no row, search the logs for the `InvoiceEmail` tag, then look in the S3 `invoices/` and `unparsable/` folders.
